title: CI job scheduler and its unit tests
name: CI job scheduler

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how these tests verify the scheduler's behavior? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
With maxConcurrent = 1, a priority-3 job fails on its first attempt while a priority-3 job and a priority-1 job are already queued. Where is the failed job placed?
choices: At the front of the queue
After the other priority-3 job and before the priority-1 job
At the very end of the queue
It is not requeued until dispatch is called

questions.prompt: What does `complete(jobId, true)` do for a job that is still in the queued state?
choices: Marks it succeeded and removes it from the queue
Nothing; it returns early because the job is not running

questions.prompt: Why do tests construct a new JobScheduler in every `it` while sharing the module-level `seq` counter?
choices: The counter only makes ids unique; each scheduler instance holds its own queue and job map so tests cannot see each other's jobs
Sharing seq makes tests order-dependent because ids must start at job-1
The scheduler rejects ids it has seen in any previous instance
